title: Vitest
description: Lightning-fast unit test framework powered by Vite.

data.text: Vitest is a blazing fast unit test framework powered by Vite. It supports ESM, TypeScript, and JSX out of the box.

data.title: Vitest test

data.text: A Jest-compatible Runner Built on Vite

Vitest reuses the Vite config, so path aliases, TypeScript, and JSX work with no extra setup. Its API mirrors Jest — `describe`, `it`, `expect`, `vi.fn` — so migrating is mostly mechanical. Because it runs on Vite, it is fast and handles ESM natively.

data.title: A test with Vite aliases and vi

data.text: A jsdom or happy-dom environment covers most component tests, while browser mode runs the suite in a real browser for tests that need layout or canvas. Coverage uses the V8 provider by default, and `--coverage` reports per-file line and branch percentages.

data.title: Configuring the environment and coverage
Vitest is now the default for Vite projects
data.text: If a project already uses Vite, Vitest avoids the config duplication that Jest requires. For an existing Jest codebase the migration cost is real but small. Say that the reason to choose it is shared configuration, not that Jest is obsolete.
